reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share some significant updates in Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible for players around the world. Additionally, we've improved placement feedback to clearly indicate why certain placements fail, helping you build more efficiently. Plus, our day/night transitions are smoother than ever, ensuring your colony runs seamlessly as the sky changes. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Multilingual Support and Enhanced Gameplay
steam.body: We're excited to announce that Provincia's build UI now supports ten languages! This update makes the game more accessible to players worldwide. Additionally, we've improved the placement feedback system, allowing you to understand why certain placements fail, and we've smoothed out the day/night transitions for a better gameplay experience. For more information, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
